name: Allen & Heath dLive (TypeScript module)
notes: TypeScript module for dLive consoles over MIDI over TCP (protocol V2.0, README); get actions of the protocol are not implemented. All actions of src/actions.ts (UpdateActions) and all feedbacks of src/feedbacks.ts (UpdateFeedbacks) are catalogued; the manifest lists the id allenheath-dlive with the legacy id allenheath-dlive-ilive.

Channel selection options come from getChannelSelectOptions (src/utils/getChannelSelectOptions.ts): one dropdown for the channel type and one dropdown per type that is shown only for that type (visibleWhen). The action does not need a separate action per channel type or per channel. Dropdown ids are zero-based numbers (id 0 = "Input Channel 1"). With the prefix argument the ids are prefixed, e.g. destinationChannelType and destinationMonoAux. The catalog repeats the option set per action because the include and exclude lists differ.

The channel types are input, mono_group, stereo_group, mono_aux, stereo_aux, mono_matrix, stereo_matrix, mono_fx_send, stereo_fx_send, fx_return, main, dca, mute_group, stereo_ufx_send, stereo_ufx_return; mute_group is excluded where an action cannot address it. Counts per type come from src/constants.ts (for example 128 inputs, 62 mono groups, 24 DCAs, 500 scenes, 2000 cue list ids).

Fader levels are the 128 MIDI steps 0..127 (0 = -INF, 107 = 0.0 dB, 127 = +10.0 dB). The EQ and HPF frequency lists are the 128 MIDI values, the labels are computed from the converter functions and are not listed.

The module has two repositories with overlapping scope (this one for dLive only, and bitfocus/companion-module-allenheath-dlive-ilive for dLive and iLive); each manifest lists the other id under legacyIds, and the source does not show which one Companion currently installs for a new connection. Catalogued separately.
Built on @companion-module/base ^1.4.0 (1.x): option values do not support expressions, although the options set isVisibleExpression.
Not catalogued: config fields, variables, presets and the validators in src/validators.
